_: Kanto's story key items (the owner's rule, 2026-10-16: what a scene hands you goes in the Bag, a keepsake with no use). Each region keeps its own file here; build.sh embeds them all (KEY_ITEMS). Icons: resources/sprites/items.

pokeball.d: The Poké Balls Professor Oak gave you on Route 1 to catch your first wild Pokémon.

ssticket.d: Bill's ticket for the S.S. Anne, the cruise ship that docks in Vermilion City.

pokeflute.d: Mr. Fuji's flute. Its tune can wake even the deepest sleeper.

tripass.d: Bill's pass for the Seagallop ferry, good for One, Two and Three Island.

rainbowpass.d: Celio's upgrade of your Tri-Pass: the Seagallop ferries take you to all seven of the Sevii Islands.
